title: Megurine Luka — Card Story

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Say, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look at this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The virtual show from the other day is being made available online for a limited time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? The event where all six VIRTUAL SINGERS appear?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's the one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're rotating videos every day to showcase all six of them, and today is Luka's turn!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh! May I watch too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! That's why I called to you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Play!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you've been enjoying yourself so far.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's good.
I'll be singing from my heart today in order to reach yours.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's start with this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... Luka is just so lovely.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's cool, mysterious, and mature.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The songs she sings are usually like that, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mature love songs, melodies that are calm and graceful...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And she's got the perfect voice for sexy and cool songs too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I also like how she dances in her faster songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? She has fast songs?
What are they like?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure we can find something with a quick search... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Maybe we don't need to search after all. Listen...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is such a bright and happy song!
I feel like I'm seeing a new side of Luka!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. You found this video but you seem so surprised by what's inside.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I only watched the beginning because I wanted to watch the rest together with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I feel like singing now, too!
Ichi, let's go sing karaoke after school today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Today?
I don't have work so sure, why not.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! I'm gonna try out all the songs that Luka sang!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, alright.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Moving on to the next song...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope everyone's still keeping up!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
My name is Megurine Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you've been enjoying yourself so far.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's good.
I'll be singing from my heart today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's start with this song...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? That sounds like Megurine Luka?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where is it coming from, though...? Ah.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Looks like it's this shop.
They even have a poster of Luka on the window.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, what does this shop even sell?
CDs...no wait. Musical instruments, I think?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't see what's inside because of the poster...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Going to work?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah. What about you?
Ichika's not with you today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi has work, and I'm on my way to mine too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, what were you looking around for just now? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nothing... I heard Megurine Luka's voice from this shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do they sell here?
They're not open yet, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Seems that way.
There are a lot of cafes and bars that feature live music along this street, after all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe I should tell...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Tell who what?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's a Megurine Luka fan in this band I know whose dream is to perform together with the VIRTUAL SINGER one day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This band's set list will always have a cover song of one of the VIRTUAL SINGERS when they perform.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, they're mostly Megurine Luka's songs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! What songs do they cover?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm, I think they were doing this the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's such a cool song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They are a band after all, so the songs they cover are usually rock songs like this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She also sings a lot of English songs, so you can hear her doing jazz sometimes, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right, Luka's English pronunciation is so good after all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sigh... I'm so envious...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
She's good-looking, cool, and fluent in English!
Don't you wish you could become like that, too?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The event isn't over yet!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We have plenty more exciting songs waiting in the wings, so I hope everyone can look forward to it!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You want to know what it's like to have someone look up to you?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! If you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What's this about, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The other day Miku said that Luka was sort of like her mentor, remember?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I missed out on a lot of middle school, so I didn't get to experience the whole dynamics between upper and underclassmen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it has always fascinated me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You idolize this sort of interpersonal relationship, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Since this SEKAI is born from our feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe Saki's longing to have an older student to look up to translated into Luka being Miku's mentor?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm good friends with a senior in my club, but I wonder about other people's experiences.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You mean the captain of the soft tennis club?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! She's really nice and very considerate towards me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She even came up with a special practice routine for me since I had a very long break from sports.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's great that she looks after you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! And you know, she even talks a bit like you. She sounds so mature and cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't that right, Ichi? You've met her too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Definitely, she does resemble Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The vibe between you and Miku reminds me of my club captain and younger members.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You must be an amazing mentor to Miku, just like my captain!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't really tell if I'm doing a good job or not...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But when we're practicing together, I often feel like Miku looks up to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I bet she does! You've got such a wholesome relationship!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So what's it like to have someone younger that you can teach the ropes to?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see, what could I compare it to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose it's like having a younger sister.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A younger sister, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... So it's like the relationship between siblings...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That's not helpful to you, Saki, since you only have an older brother.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but I kind of get it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can sort of imagine what it'd be like if I put myself in Tsukasa's shoes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Then I guess it's just me not knowing what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you're the only child.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have no idea what it feels like having siblings.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess that's something you can't understand unless you experience it yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Dang... Now I want a junior who'd be like a younger sibling to me!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll have someone like that one day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And when I do, I'll be a fabulous role model to them, like you are to Miku!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, you might be setting the bar a bit too high there...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What, don't you believe in me?
I will become a kind, stylish, and responsible senior student someday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, that'll be interesting to see.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me, Luka.
Would this be a good time for a chat?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, Honami.
Is it just you today?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What would you like to talk to me about?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well... I was hoping to get your advice about something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Go on then, ask me anything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You see, I...don't feel like I can cope with performing in front of an audience.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why not? You've been doing so well in your rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you but...
It's not about my technique.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've just begun to think that maybe drums aren't my thing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami, why don't we sit down? This is a very important matter to you, so we should make ourselves comfortable and take our time talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, why do you think drums aren't for you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I learned to play percussion instruments when I joined the school's brass band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why it seemed natural that I should become the drummer in our band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But in this kind of band, the role of the drummer is much more important than what I was used to from the brass band...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I set the rhythm for the entire band.
Everyone depends on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I...don't have the confidence to play such an important role.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Tell me, Honami, do you dislike playing drums?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, no, I have nothing against drums per se.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's good.
And did anyone in the band complain about your drumming?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, no one's said anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought so.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But then there's no reason for you to think drums aren't the right instrument for you, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't you agree, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki told me that my drumming's easy to follow, and even Shiho said it's good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I can play drums fairly well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... Sometimes I get anxious thinking that maybe I shouldn't be the one to do this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I just wanted to tell somebody about these doubts.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
It really wasn't worth mentioning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I'm glad you told me about this. Everyone loses confidence sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But, Honami, you should remember...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're surrounded by friends who believe in you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In those moments when you stop believing in yourself, think about them, and trust their judgement.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They believe in me even when I don't...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My doubts won't disappear so easily, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do my best to keep playing as best I can for my friends who rely on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Keep enjoying what you do!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a beautiful, starlit sky...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't reach any of them no matter how much I stretch my hand out. Hehe... Silly me. Of course I can't.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm sure she can definitely...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Miku. Finished practicing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Penny for your thoughts, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well, I was just thinking about her.
Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika... Her true feelings are right in front of her, yet she doesn't seem to acknowledge them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Despite that, she's still doing what she can to reach out to Honami right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I made a wish to the stars that she'll be able to convey her feelings properly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her feelings of wanting to be together like before, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Ichika and the girls don't know Honami's true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why they think allowing Honami to continue sticking close to her other friends may be for the best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope Honami can tell them her true feelings one day too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She may not because she's too good-natured.
That's why she's struggling too. She's not sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not being able to tell the people you like that you want to spend time together is just...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just speak your mind. Why the hesitation?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you need me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you want to be with me forever?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wh-What's this, all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm still waiting for your answer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. See?
It's not that easy to speak your mind without any hesitation, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: W-Wait a minute, that has nothing to do with this... Oh, come on...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Some things are hard to convey properly, even among those who know each other well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's understandable that those who have drifted apart for a time would be even more cautious as a result.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But they're working up the courage to reach out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're all still within reach, unlike this starlit sky.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're right...
And I'm sure they'll succeed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: After all, if Honami is truly already out of Ichika's reach...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her feelings wouldn't be a part of this SEKAI at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. This SEKAI is full of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The plushies in the classroom, the star chart on the blackboard...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Even this beautiful starry night sky is a part of everyone's memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be something deeply engraved in their hearts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I said they shouldn't be so hesitant...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I know it's frustrating, but let's have faith in them and watch over them together, alright?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Until they can all find their true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, a shooting star.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great! I'm going to make a wish too.
I wish that the girls will be able to convey their true feelings to each other!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, Miku.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
Just the two of you today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, we have something to talk to you about today...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Me?
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, well... We wanted to say thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whatever for?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For calling me to this SEKAI, and...helping me to face my feelings honestly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for all of that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were able to face your feelings because you wanted to, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not really... I wouldn't have been able to do it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was because of everyone's encouragement and that starlit sky from our memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See? I didn't do anything at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember we told you that this SEKAI is made from your feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That starlit sky only appeared here because it had remained in everyone's memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You saw it because it remained in your memories too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Ichika told me that it was you and Miku who suggested showing me the starlit sky back then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I still think I should say thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's not like I did anything special...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm glad that motivated you to face your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me... Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm the same.
I wanted to thank you too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was because of you and Miku that I decided to join the band Ichika started and patch things up with Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So...
Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
I was only doing what I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so glad all of you found your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels so good to be able to say thank you properly. Huh? Shiho? Why are you holding a bass guitar?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I feel like playing.
Join me, Honami and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? I don't mind, but this is very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just come on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, maybe Shiho is feeling happy?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh? Is it because you don't know what to say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, start counting already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, g-give me a second, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's play a great tune together, girls.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The stars are always so beautiful here...hmm?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah, Luka! Hello there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello there, Saki. I haven't seen you since we used the rooftop as a play-planetarium.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm glad you seem to be in good health today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Actually, I brought some photos that Hona took for us the other day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...these are shots from the play-planetarium.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They're very well taken.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know! Please show them to Miku too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I will.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And now you can tell me what you're really here for.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah... Haha, you can really read me like an open book.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, I'm here to say thanks, actually.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, for listening to me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You told me back then that there was no need for me to rush.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I think those words really put me at great ease.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why I'm all better now. It's all because of you, Luka. So thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You didn't have to worry about it at all, really.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you found your true feelings in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you let us hear the wonderful songs that were born from those feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To Miku and myself, that's more than enough thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So now, just go out there and do whatever you like, and enjoy life to your heart's content.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's what we want to see all of you doing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so reassuring to have someone like you and Miku I can look up to as my seniors!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... If I ever need help for anything in the future, can I drop by to talk to you again, in secret?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Without telling Ichika, Shiho, and Honami?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes. Secretly and without letting them know!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, there are some things you wouldn't be able to share freely with those who've known you since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I'm happy to lend you a listening ear anytime you like. Miku would say the same thing too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's already quite late. Let's stop for today, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay. Good night!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, good night to you too, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like Saki's made a full recovery.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, she has. Miku, you didn't come in just now so that it would be easier for Saki to speak with me, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were outside the classroom from halfway through.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup. She just recovered from an illness. It wouldn't be nice for me to make her stay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Besides, Saki's here to thank you today, wasn't she?
I didn't want to be in the way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that why? But she said it's so reassuring to have someone like Miku she can look up to—

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, well, that's...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Oh, Miku. You heard what she said, didn't you?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Maybe you didn't come in because you were blushing?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka? Why are you staring at me like that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, nothing in particular.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay. That sounded pretty good!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Practicing hard, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, Ichika and the girls are getting so much better these days, so I have to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay. How long will you practice for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I just finished my section practice, so I'm done for today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well then, I should show you what you missed the other day.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What did I miss?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Something our dear juniors shared with us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Here. Photos of the play-planetarium session that Saki brought the other day when she came over.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, show me show me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, this was taken when we were toasting with our drinks. This was when Honami was doing narration.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this one... Oh!
They were playing rock-paper-scissors to see who would get the remaining snacks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone looks so happy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. There's even a picture of sleepy-looking Saki.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm really so glad Saki is back on her feet again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So am I, and I'm sure Ichika, Shiho, and Honami are as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They've always wanted to be of some help to her, after all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki's always smiling even when overexerting herself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Indeed...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She would be by herself in a hospital room far away, when everyone was spending time together in school.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must have been lonely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That was probably why she was rushing to make up for all that lost time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. But it feels like she had gotten over all that during the play-planetarium, all thanks to you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I just gave her a listening ear, that's all.
I'm glad to know that turned out to be somewhat helpful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think about it, Ichika and the girls were making plans to go to a few other fun places together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Like different shops and events.
Everyone was doing their part and trying to research different places.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's really nice.
Making plans together can be a very fun activity in itself.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's how they intend to keep on making fond memories together, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see what sort of memories they'll be making.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup. They've only just formed the band too.
I'm sure they'll keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is only just the beginning for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope I can keep watching over them as they grow.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. They may lose their way or face obstacles again, like they did this time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may even be things they'll hold back from saying to each other because of being childhood friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When that happens, we'll be there to lend them a helping hand. There must be something we can do for them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're going all in, aren't you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anything for my dearest junior classmen.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to be a supportive senior classman like you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I personally think you're already one, though?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, really!
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Honami, thank you for drawing a fortune for me.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You don't need to thank me...
I mean, especially considering the outcome...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, I don't think it was really all that bad.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If this is rock bottom in terms of my luck, things can only get better from here.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, did you all draw fortunes already?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No. Only for Miku and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then what are we waiting for? Let's see what we get!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Honami, why not draw another one?
I'm sure it'll be better this time!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Let's hope for the best!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Honami seems pretty fired up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, she is. So are we getting our fortunes, or what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay, what did you get?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Minor blessing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Huh... Oh, look at the part about education!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Be sure to work hard, but your rewards will be modest...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, so I won't get good grades even if I work hard? How can anyone feel like studying after getting this?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But under general luck it says, Attention to detail will improve your luck.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It could be taken as a warning against carelessness.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see. Like when you accidentally skip one row on a multiple choice test and your answers all end up in the wrong place...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay, this is pretty rough.
I'll make sure to be careful...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And what did you get, Saki?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! I got a... Blessing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Under education it says, Study without worrying!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow... Our fortunes are miles apart...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But under finances it says, Be careful. Avoid impulse buying or you'll greatly regret them later...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Greatly regret them...?
What on earth am I going to buy?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmm... You could end up buying some clothes at one store and find out later that they're 50% off at another one?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right... When Saki finds something she really likes, she tends to buy it on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-Then... I'll be more careful when I'm shopping this year...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What did you get, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll check it now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh! Luka, look! Finally!
A blessing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's great, Honami!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by finally?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. This is her third try.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? When did she get so many...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The general luck part is very positive too. It says, Your efforts will bring happiness to those around you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I'll do my best to make that come true...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Calm down a little. You're acting like you just drew a great blessing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Did you, Shiho?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got a good blessing. That's good enough for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So... Shiho's the best of us all, then Honami and me, and then Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hold on, I'm getting another one.
I mean, Honami had a few tries so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What did you get before this one, Hona? Don't tell me you drew a great curse or something...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eek...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Come on! Show me that one!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They're really enjoying this.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah... Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Why are you sighing while staring at your fortune?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You got a good blessing, right?>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. And the part about education not being a problem is nice. But the part about wishes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Let's see... You'll worry others and have difficult choices to make...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's odd. The rest of the fortune is very good, but this part doesn't bode all that well.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. But I don't think you should worry about it too much, Shiho.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you let it get to you, it might stop you from accomplishing what you've set out to do and turn into a self-fulfilling prophecy.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. It's just a fortune...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho! Let's tie up our fortunes!
We can make our wish plaques after that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, I thought we already did everything?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Luka, they're writing their wishes next!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. I guess we get to enjoy this shrine visit a little bit longer.>
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, are you in here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Luka. You came to see me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I have something for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's the fortune Honami drew for you when the girls went to the shrine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it... Didn't they tie their fortunes to a tree outside the shrine?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It's to have the life force of the tree help grant their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, so that's why...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami said to just let her know if you want to have yours tied up too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so nice of her! She's such a kind girl.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but sometimes to the point that she ends up taking too much responsibility.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, like when she drew a fortune for you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Here, take a look...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait... Is this your fortune?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She drew me another one before coming here because she still felt bad about the very first one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha. Classic Honami...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought it was very sweet of her to do this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She really wants us all to have the best of luck this year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Have you looked inside yet?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I'll open it now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A great blessing...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's the best one there is, right? Wow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It must be full of good predictions, right?
Let's read them together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, this one's about our finances... Well, that's meaningless to us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The part about education doesn't really apply to us either. Or maybe it does? You'll pick up new skills effortlessly. Makes me feel smarter, so I can work with that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can also skip the bit about health... So next is... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What is it? Something good?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See here, under general luck?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You won't have to wait long for your dreams to come true. What are you wishing for, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's already become a reality.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My dream was for our friends to have a great time playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You didn't have to wait at all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does Honami know what fortune she got for you this time?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I don't think so.
I'll have to tell her the next time she comes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You know, I think I have a more exciting idea. Why not tie the fortune somewhere in here for her to find?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that!
But what would be a good spot?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's look for a suitable place together!
Whoever finds one first can be the winner!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You always come up with fun ideas!
Okay, I'm game!

rows.Speaker: Luka & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for lending me an ear, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It was my pleasure.
Feel free to come visit any time♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I will. See you later then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry, you'll find your answer.
After all, you're not alone, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, I should get back to setting up for the show... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin? You look upset. Is there something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, well... Actually, I overheard your conversation with Shizuku just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And, you know... I'm worried about her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. If you go around looking so upset, your fans are going to worry about you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know... But still...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's my fault that Shizuku is having so much trouble right now...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I get the impression there's a specific reason behind your worrying, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well... Airi came to visit me before, and she was saying that she needed something called an agency in order to be an idol.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I said I was sure she and the others would be able to give others hope regardless of how they did it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I told her that they didn't need to be in an agency to do that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And now it looks like that's the reason they've decided to become idols on their own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But after seeing Shizuku like that, I'm not so sure it was a good idea to say those things...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure the fans would be happier and more supportive if I kept being the idol they expect to see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back then, I was happy knowing that I was living up to their expectations.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I can't do that on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't think I should've said those things.
Now, because of me, Shizuku is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're such a kind person, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But think about what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you think those girls are so irresponsible that they'd do something just because somebody told them to?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, of course not!
They're all serious about becoming idols.
They want to inspire hope in others!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good, I'm glad we agree.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So don't worry. I'm sure they put a lot of thought into the path they've chosen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Besides, I don't think what Shizuku is worried about right now has anything to do with their decision about not joining an agency.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I think Shizuku is worried about is how she can meet the expectations her fans have of her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's trying to decide whether or not to continue playing the version of her that was created by others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think she would have eventually had to deal with the same question even if she had joined an agency.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I think I understand what you're trying to say!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still... This is going to be tough on Shizuku regardless of which path ends up choosing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's true. But I'm sure by persisting, she'll be able to find the answer she's looking for.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe she's strong enough to get through this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm also very much looking forward to seeing what she finds at the end of this journey.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What do you think it'll be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure whatever it is, we'll all be dazzled...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I get the feeling it will give her the ability to fill people's hearts with hope♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hope she finds it soon!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I do too. We'll just have to wait until she does.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That was a lot of fun today.
Let's meet tomorrow at the same... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good afternoon, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh! Welcome, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me the other day even though I stopped by without any warning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was my pleasure♪
So, have you found your answer?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have. I've decided to show everyone who I really am. The real Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I told my fans the same thing in our livestream. I said that I want them to see me as part of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's wonderful! How did they react?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not everyone was supportive, but most of them left comments saying that they'd cheer me on.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It made me so happy that I keep re-watching the stream to read the comments again and again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great. I'm happy you were able to convey your feelings to them, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, hey! Is there any way for us to watch your video?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? Oh, I don't see why not...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Would you mind showing it to us then?
I'm sure Rin would love to see it as well♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You too, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course.
She's been so worried.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think it would be great for her to see your bravery at work too. Would that be all right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're making me blush, but sure.
Well then... How about tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Rin and I will be waiting!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Shizuku♪
And Minori too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray! Minori's here too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she is. I asked her to come with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Sorry again, Minori.
I just can't figure this tablet out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize.
Everyone has trouble with something!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Besides, coming with you means I get to watch the video with Rin and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I've been looking forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Alright, everyone!
Time to begin our exclusive screening!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hurray♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And... Play!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, look! It's Shizuku!
And look at all the text flying by on the side!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ah, these must be the comments you mentioned yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's right. All the fans can send messages and share what they're feeling. Isn't it amazing?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, here comes the part where Shizuku makes her announcement.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: My heart is pounding...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad Rin seems to be back to her normal self♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To tell you the truth, Rin has been feeling a bit down recently. She's been worrying it was her fault you four were struggling.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She has?
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She was afraid your troubles were due to her comment about you not needing an agency to be idols.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not at all. We were the ones who ultimately made the decision to freelance as an independent group...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I told her as much, so please don't worry.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I thought it would be best for her to see for herself instead of just hearing it from me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See, look♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! Shizuku looks so cool!
It's like she's glowing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right?! I've already watched this a bunch of times already, but I can't help but feel amazed every time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean! Let's watch it again♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You told me before that you were sure there'd be those who would support me for who I am now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well... It would seem they were closer than I imagined.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. I'm happy you found them♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? You look like you're having fun, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I have a feeling that something really, really good is gonna happen today☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Something really good? Like what?
Tsukasa and the others coming over, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... I dunno♪
But I'm so excited...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, look☆
All the plushies are running this way!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Miku! Len!
Heeelp!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! What's wrong, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Just come with us! Hurry!
We need your help!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Here! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Look! Her!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Her? Where...? Ohhh...!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Mumble*...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: L-Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪ I didn't know you were here☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me neither! But why's she asleep?
Luka... Luka, wake up...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*...
Hm...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka! Good morning☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...? Miku? Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yes, it's us! We're so glad you're here!
This SEKAI is just so much fun♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really is♪ Especially all the shows we do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shows? That does sound like fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But... Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She fell asleep! No, Luka, wake up!
If you can get yourself to that stage over there, you can see KAITO and MEIKO too...!

Welcome, Luka!

rows.Line:
Thank goodness, you're all here♪

rows.Line: I know, right? It's like Luka can fall asleep anywhere at anytime...

rows.Speaker: Miku

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. We should tell everyone else that we have a new friend with us now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah♪ We should as soon as we can☆
You wanna meet them too, right, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially if their feelings created this SEKAI...♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Yay!
Tag! You're it!

rows.Line: Ready or not, here I come♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's so full of energy.

rows.Line: This Doll Festival party is also your welcoming party, so we want you to have as much fun as possible♪

rows.Line:

rows.Line: That being said, it's still sort of a wonder as to how you actually understand what she's saying...

rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Line: I'd like to hear about how his party went the next time he comes here...

rows.Line:

Mind if I borrow your lap?

rows.Line:
Fine, alright. Come here, you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank...
Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Line:
Already...?!

rows.Line: What?! Luka fell asleep?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That'll have to wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Mumble*...

rows.Line: She must be having a nice dream.

rows.Line: But why is it that she can sleep this much...?

rows.Line: Does it have to do with her connection to this SEKAI? Possibly how Tsukasa's feelings were part of why this SEKAI came to be...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Line: You have?

rows.Line: When they're having fun or enjoying themselves, she starts falling asleep.

rows.Line: I see...

rows.Line: The opposite seems to be true as well since she's almost never sleepy when something is bothering someone.

rows.Line: She'll attentively listen to what someone has to say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Line: Come to think of it, Luka looked fully awake when Tsukasa was talking to her about something pretty serious...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Line: So whenever Luka feels like being a sleepyhead, it's a good thing!

rows.Line: Then this SEKAI must be overflowing with smiles and joy considering she can sleep this soundly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz... Hehe...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka

rows.Line: Your singing and dancing just keep improving! I can't wait hear how your show goes!

rows.Line: Me too! We'd do anything to see you perform!

rows.Line: Hehe. Hearing that gives me a lot of confidence...

rows.Line: Anyways, I'll see you tomorrow...

rows.Line: Wait, Minori?! Is everything okay?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I'm just hungry and tired, so it's making me feel sleepy...

rows.Line: We did practice quite a lot. Please, make sure to rest and refuel when you get home♪

rows.Line: And a nice long bath! Oh, but not too long. You might catch a cold!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Line: Minori's really trying her best♪

rows.Line: She is. I was a little worried that she was trying too hard but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? Are you still worried about her?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Only a little bit. I mean, she's really putting everything into it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Relaxing is just as important as practicing, right? But I think she'll be fine now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right. A long shows do require quite a bit of stamina...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...! Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka?

rows.Line:
I thought of something good♪

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
Thanks for having me again today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's get started... Oh, but today's practice will feel a little different than normal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! D-Does that mean it's going to be really hard...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That may be up to you, Minori.
Would you be up for it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Of course! Anything you ask!
Please, I'd like to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
In that case...
Minori, what's your favorite kind of fish?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Fish...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Such as tuna or maybe some other kind...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Salmon, maybe? It's so yummy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ah, okay. We have tuna, salmon and...
Let's throw an otter in as well♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: An otter? But otters aren't a type of fish...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But let's start with a tuna dance♪
Did you know that tuna fish have to keep swimming for as long as they can?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So I want you to...!
Do box steps as fast as you can♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?! L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And when I say, Salmon, I want you to start skipping like there's no tomorrow♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And when I say, Otter, I want you to stop on a dime and start waving your hips all loosey goosey♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:

Faster! More! Like you mean it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah! Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, is that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, I think I understand what you mean...

rows.Line: And otter!

rows.Line: Okay! Loosey goosey...

rows.Line: Yeah. Loosey goosey...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Everyone, like an otter!

rows.Line: Okay, here we go♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hiii, Riiin. Hiii, Miiiku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Line:
Hello!
Thanks for having me again today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Welcome, Minori♪

rows.Line:
But are you sure you don't need a break?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, but I'm okay. I feel like my body can really keep up now, so I want to practice!

rows.Line: Also, I'm the one that asked you to help me practice!

rows.Line: But only as long as I'm not being a bother to you, Luka...!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Anyways, shall we get started♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! Thank you!

rows.Line:
Luka, thanks again for today!

rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to do the fishy box step again.

rows.Line: Yeah! She's really been giving it everything she has!

rows.Line: I agree. Luka, you've been a great teacher as well♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I have?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's learned to relax and have confidence in herself thanks to you. It's done wonders for her.

rows.Line: Hehe. Well, maybe just a little.

rows.Line: She was that driven and her passion made it all a reality.

rows.Line:
Her passion, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka

rows.Line:
Welcome, Minori♪
I'm looking forward to another good session!

rows.Line:
Oh, that's great!

rows.Line: First, when you move to the back as others move to the front of the stage!

rows.Line: In this case, everyone in the back danced a little more discretely to let everyone in the front stand out more!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, very good♪

rows.Line: Right! During long instrumental parts as well! Instead of dancing in place, everyone tried to make eye contact with the audience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What else...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's wonderful, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Teehee...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was really focused on trying my best or doing everything I can, but I'm understanding how important it is to stay loose now too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's really incredible just how much of a difference it makes, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad that I could help, Minori♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this rabbit hole goes much deeper than that, you know.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. I got a sense of that too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Each time watched that DVD, I kept finding new things that I never even thought to look for.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It just means that you're learning to see things from an idol's point of view, no?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You even found some fans that truly believe in you thanks to your videos, right? Fans you want to give hope.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As you keep learning about who you're trying to give hope to, I'm sure your understanding will keep evolving along with it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Minori's taken quite a big step forward as an idol...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It may be only a matter of time until the hard-working Minori that we first met blooms into a beautiful idol.)

rows.Line:

rows.Line: It's Phenny...

rows.Line:

rows.Line: Some people even call him Phenny Penguin!

rows.Line: There's this girl in my class that really loves PXL and taught me all about it!

rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about Hinomori?

rows.Line: Actually, no. Shiho loves Phenny too, but it's this other girl that I'm really close with...

rows.Line: <Did you see that? Everyone cheered when Phenny flapped his wings just now.>

rows.Line: Someone may've said the magic words Otori was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Magic words?

rows.Line: Yes. Apparently, if you say the magic words, Phenny will do cute things for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, I see. It's his form of fan service...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You may be right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That means Phenny is this amusement park's idol, no?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An idol...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just thinking that we could learn a few things from Phenny in term of how to treat our fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask him to fly for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, I wanna see that too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We'll be hiding in your pocket in the meantime.>

rows.Line: Sorry, we'll try to be quick!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I know we're here to have fun, but stopping Haruka may be a bit difficult now...>

rows.Line: <Yes, however...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm just glad that Minori's genuinely been having fun today too.>

rows.Line: <When she was practicing for their joint stream, she really didn't seem like herself...>

rows.Line: <Yeah, I remember...>

rows.Line: <And do you remember how she kept practicing even after their show was over?>

rows.Line: <I was so worried about which straw would end up breaking the camel's back but...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I feel so relieved after seeing her laugh and have fun like this.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I see.>

rows.Line: <Is this why you wanted to come here today? You have plans to go hiking in the mountains too, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I did, but I was also very interested in seeing an amusement park.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I can go off to see how Airi and the others are doing without much worry now.>

rows.Line: <Right. Are you sure you still have time to go see them, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I think so. They said that they'll tell me when they find a nice view.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That sounds so nice! I hope the four of them have a good time together...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I hope so too♪>

rows.Line: Okay, that should be enough practice for today. Great job, Shizuku! And thanks for helping us out too, Luka!

rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I had quite a bit of fun too!

rows.Line:

rows.Line: I'm learning how to tie knots from Shizuku.

rows.Line: Knots?

rows.Line: For tying ropes that you use when you're out camping or hiking.

rows.Line: Yes. You can even use these knots for the ribbons and boots in our wardrobe.
