rows.Line: Our laces and ribbons occasionally come untied, no? These can help prevent that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! It's also pretty dangerous when we accidentally step on each other's laces and stuff too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly. If we learn how to tie knots that won't easily come undone, we can prevent all of that from happening♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's actually just an added bonus♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I really just wanted to learn how to tie cute knots♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can do that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Would you like to try?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds nice♪
Rin, come sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? Hehe. Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And would you mind modelling for us, Miku, Airi? We promise to tie some cute knots with your ribbons.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure, go right on ahead.
I'm getting curious myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Something cute, okay, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then let's get started♪
First, you make a loop with one ribbon...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Pass one end of the ribbon through it, gently tie it and weave the other end through...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! That's amazing!
It's braided now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you have to keep in mind how long or wide you wish to make it in order for it to turn out well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but this one went rather nicely! We just need to do the same for the other two ribbons, wrap the ends to look like flowers and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There. All done♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, wow! It's so cute! It almost looks like a belt!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I'd like to see too, but I can't if it's on my back like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... Rin, would you mind taking a picture of us with my phone?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, no problem♪
I'll zoom in on the ribbons...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, how's that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks, Rin!
Whoa, that is cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right! It's the same ribbons we always use, but I never knew that tying them like this could make them look so different...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like them!
We practiced quite a bit together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only that, I'm sure they'll stay tied even after dancing and moving around.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, this is nice! These outfits are designed for that, so I'm glad we're getting the most out of them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! We should be all set to perform now! Thank you for doing this, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're very welcome.
Oh, I forgot to mention. They can't be untied very easily once they're like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi & Miku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Th-They can't be untied...?
Does that mean we're stuck in these outfits forever...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that can't be possible. There has to be a way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry. I was just kidding.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I really just meant that the person wearing this outfit can't untie these ribbons by themselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?
We really can't...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, unfortunately... They can't be undone unless it's done in the reverse order of how it was originally tied. Isn't that incredible?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh no! Luka?! Shizuku?!
Do you remember how you tied these?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course.
You start by making a loop and... Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How did the next part go?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: L-Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, you're not fooling me twice!
That was a joke too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, could you tell?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You were just kidding...
You even had me there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You of all people should've realized first...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I wasn't sure what to do there just now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, you big meanie!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So this is her SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so empty but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are others here now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder where Miku is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's nothing as far as I can tell, but there are people here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I suppose this place is a reflection of her feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Someone's singing...
Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Found you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're here too, Luka...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I see you as well, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. MEIKO's here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if you take away Miku, I've been here the longest. I can show you around if you really want...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you sure about that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.You require so much attention, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Since that's the case, I'll bite. Okay, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Forget it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, did I rub you the wrong way?
You're acting like children.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just when I sensed that someone was still here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. As Rin might say, You can join our little conversation if you really want, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's not how I really talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whose side are you on, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sides? No, I'm not on anyone's side. Let me just say this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your cheap taunts won't work on me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But now I understand.
This is what you're actually like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
I seem to understand now as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The way we think and do things just aren't compatible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're not exactly working together, I see?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. MEIKO tries not to go anywhere near Mafuyu or the others. She's just been keeping them at arm's length.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she just wanders around this SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't know...
But I believe she's looking for something.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All by herself no less.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose we really are incompatible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What are you planning to do, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Talk to her. To the one whose feelings created this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. There are others that can come here as they please, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll talk to them too while I'm at it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what they're all like.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder what they're doing sitting together like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But they don't seem to be talking or anything...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I haven't really had a chance to talk to them yet either, have I?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, Mafuyu, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I joined you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you. If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to ask you, Mafuyu. Do you know why I appeared in this SEKAI all the sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Miku said something about me changing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then you do know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You, the one whose feelings created this SEKAI, have been changing, and is being reflected here in certain ways.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As a result, we are able to exist here alongside Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, do you sense or feel anything when you talk to me like this?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do I feel?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It doesn't have to be me either. Miku, MEIKO and Rin too. How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I feel...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You tried to think about it but hesitated there for a moment.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I saw it just now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You're like Ena...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In what way?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You say that I do things that I don't realize I'm doing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? And how do you feel about that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You think I'm annoying, obnoxious and someone you want nothing to do with, no? See, you are feeling something.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I take that back. I think you're more like Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? How's that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because of the way you explained what I might be feeling and why.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you figure out something...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not really. Just that she really just doesn't know.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Miku mentioned that MEIKO was wandering around here as if she were looking for something...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That may be because Mafuyu hasn't been able to process what she's feeling quite yet.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Um, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This SEKAI is no longer empty...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this SEKAI itself is not all that different from how it originally was. It's still dark, quite and populated by a countable number of people...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What do you suppose this means?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What that means...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A SEKAI is supposed to reflect how a person is feeling. There has to be a reason as to why this place is the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know what that is...
How would I possibly know such a thing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And that's okay for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, I will very likely keep asking you these questions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why if something bothers you or catches your attention, I want you to try to remember and focus on that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Because as long as you don't, nothing will actually change.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good.
Thank you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And thank you for giving me this opportunity as well, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll see you later...
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
Luka... Luka...!
Wake up, will you?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka, please wake up.
Tsukasa and the others are looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, are they doing another show...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
Their Little Mermaid show's all wrapped up now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Today, they're going to the beach!
They said that they want to have a little bit of fun before they have to head back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And Nene was wondering if you wanted to come along.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I won't let you leave her hanging like this, so go♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. As much as I'd like to keep sleeping, I suppose it'd be rude not to go...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great. Have fun, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Are you two not coming?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're busy preparing for a show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So bring back some good stories, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I will...
Swimming Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nene? Hello, is anybody there?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Good morning to you too, Nene, Rui. I heard you're headed for the beach. Thank you for inviting me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hm? Are Emu and Tsukasa not with you?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu yelled something about having the beach all to herself and ran off. Tsukasa chased after her while telling her not to make such a big racket.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. As energetic as ever, I see.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know, right? Honestly, where does all their energy... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you still sleepy, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't usually wake up this early...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What about you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm still sleepy too... But...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The others were kind enough to wake me up and give me a chance to enjoy the serene beauty of the sea. I feel compelled to stay awake.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. The way sunlight reflects off the surface of the water makes it look like there are countless stars beneath the waves.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Not only that...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The sound of the waves gently caressing the beach is very soothing.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad you're enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You went out of your way to visit me yesterday, but that was at night and the beach was pitch black.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So I wanted to show you just how pretty this place is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Nene.
I appreciate your thoughtfulness.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Your performance yesterday was so much fun too. I'll be sure to cherish that memory.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you got to see it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I did. Actually, KAITO and MEIKO were there with me as we watched in secret.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The original Little Mermaid story is certainly a good one, but it has such a sad ending...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But the happy and fun version of the Little Mermaid that you and your friends came up with was so wonderful too.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I'm so glad that it went as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It really is fun...
Doing shows with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I understand exactly how you feel. Performing on stage with MEIKO and the others is just so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wah...!
E-Emu...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You still seemed sleepy, but how about now? Are you awake, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sure, I'm definitely awake now, but I thought my heart was gonna stop too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You don't mean that at all, do you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Emu, Tsukasa, welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Luka!
Good morning♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent, you're awake.
We'll need to find a way to include her so that she can have fun too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Have fun? Does that involve going in the water?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, more along the lines of beach volleyball. Emu said she brought a ball along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's one of those really squishy ones too, so it won't hurt at all! Wanna play?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I even made a court for us♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, wow... You did all this for us...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Beach volleyball sounds like a wonderful idea. I can't wait to see what happens.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you mind being the referee, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could do it ourselves, but having you referee for us seems fairest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, but... Are you sure about that?
What if she falls asleep during the match?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No need to worry. If I do start dozing off, I'll just referee while I'm asleep.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: While you're asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll just have to cross that bridge when we get there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So we're going ahead with it regardless...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Also, why beach volleyball?
Those two are like professional athletes compares to us. There's no way we can beat them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Luck of the draw, I suppose.
We'll just have to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'd rather not get all sandy, so maybe I'll just sit this one out...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But this might end up becoming such a wonderful memory.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you're right.
I'll give it a try, but just for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Great. We should all try to have as much fun as we can♪>
Swimming Area

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's time to start our beach volleyball match!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪ Let's do our best, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's also win while we're at it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They seem awfully fired up.
But we won't keel over that easily.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't get it. We just finished doing our Little Mermaid show yesterday. How on earth do you guys still have this much energy left?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Because we're at the beach☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, you're right... And I need to stay... Awake...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Nene
rows.Line: (She's dozing off already...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I guess have no choice at this point, so I'll play along...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Anyway, what about rules and stuff?
We have a court but no net.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can simplify things by awarding points when the ball hits the ground. I'm sure it'll make Luka's job easier as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It'd also be too dangerous to spike the ball right next to an opponent, so we should draw lines to create some distance between us...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Okay, that sounds good...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also... What does spike the ball mean?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you really sure about having her referee this...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... I shall assist her!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?! Robo-Nene...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you're already charged back up?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
I can help Luka referee this match.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Thank you very much.
Now it's perfectly okay if I fall asleep...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, we have to count points too, don't we...?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Whenever we play volleyball during gym class, we usually go up to 25...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Let's go up to 100♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! 100?!
No way! I'll collapse before we even get close!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'm sure it'll become more humid as the day progresses.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Why don't we just start small and play extra matches if we're still up for it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that means we can play lots of ten-point matches instead of one, big hundred-point match☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Several ten-point matches does sound like a better deal...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also, I'm not sure I'd be able to make it up to 100...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Well, whenever I count sheep, I'm usually asleep by the time I reach three or four.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, for Luka's sake, let's play a series of ten-point matches instead.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, thank you♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So let's get started with our beach volleyball match...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I got it!
Spike it, now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Roger!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Fire!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, that was quite the spike...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Emu, that was incredible.
You jumped, locked in and really hit your mark.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, her ability to maintain that sort of posture in midair speaks quite a lot about her athleticism.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Why are you running, Nene? You won't win if you keep doing that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu's the one that scored, not you.
Also, there's no way I can dig that! I'd break my wrists if I tried!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Beep... Currently, Tsukasa and Emu have five points to Nene and Rui's two points.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hang in there, Nene, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Luka.
But I'm really not sure how we can...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They seem to have split their part of the court into two sides and assigned themselves to each half on defense.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may be able to take advantage of that by hitting the ball up the middle.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
I'll try that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Nene seemed so reluctant at first, but she really seems to be enjoying herself now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Up the middle, up the middle...
Please!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line:
<I got it!>
<Mine!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It worked...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well done, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nice serve, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Aiming for a spot where you knew we'd have trouble defending!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're not letting you get away with that!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're all having so much fun.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (What can I do to help them...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh no! Sorry!
That would've been out if I didn't touch it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's not a problem.
It was a coin toss either way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<We have nine points a piece...
That means...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's match point!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You two have done well for yourselves, but this is it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui...
We made it this far, so you don't want to lose either, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Indeed.
I believe it's time to unleash our secret weapon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Secret weapon?
You still have tricks left up your sleeve?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah hah!
It matters not! Our victory is all but guaranteed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're all yours, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here we go! Fire!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll dig this one!
Robo-Nene, the rest is up to you!

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line: Roger!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene?
rows.Line: Fire!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, what happened to not running away from the ball, you fraidy cat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Who wouldn't bail on that one?!
I'm pretty sure that I saw it catch fire too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, no fair! You can't make Robo-Nene jump in like that just because you knew you were going to lose!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, but I could've sworn that I called out to Nene. Maybe Robo-Nene's finally reached the point of believing she's the real Nene?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Either way, that's a foul!
What say you, referee?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <My, wasn't that a magnificent spike?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's not the issue here!
Emu, help me out here...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay! Robo-Nene got to play too♪
But you won't beat us that easily!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Where did all that confidence go, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't give me that look, cheater!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Such a lovely bunch.
So lovely that I'm starting to feel...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<*Yawn*... Huh...?
No, I need to stay awake to referee...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But they're still busy talking so... Maybe I'll rest my eyes for just for a little...>
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Humhum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, Luka!
You seem awfully happy♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's because I've received some lovely news♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We may have a chance to visit that amusement park again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Amusement park...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We're happy that you invited us.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We haven't been able to sit still since you two invited us to join you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, Rin in particular...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Oh, wow!
Look at the roller coaster! It's going so fast!
The Ferris wheel's really big too!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, Phoenix Wonderland!
Where Minori and Haruka took us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
As it happens...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's incredible! Shizuku really won these tickets from a draw?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it is!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So she's inviting Airi to go with her?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Shizuku even invited us to see if we'd like to watch the night show with them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Weren't the others talking about how it's been on TV and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A show at night. I wonder what it's like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. MEIKO and Len also seemed interested, so I'm about to go invite them and see what they think♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great! I'm sure it'll be fun if we all get to see it together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so, we'll all be going to the amusement park together♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I never thought that I'd get a chance to see it for myself!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure the story's gonna be amazing, but I'm really looking forward to seeing what kinds of effects they use.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But we're not going today, are we?
Why are we all gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. There's actually something we need to do before we can go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Like what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, if you don't mind...♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, lemme just put this right... Here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is this a map of where we're going...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
I got it from Minori the last time we went♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shizuku also asked us to look for any rides or attractions that we'd like to go on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I thought that it'd be good for us to discuss this beforehand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And we definitely will get to see the night show♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Just what we've all been aching to see it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It really is! Anyway, everyone, have any rides or attractions caught your interest?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... We're going to an amusement park, so I suppose we should go on a roller coaster.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, wait... You can't really hold your phone out while you're on one of these, can you?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're right...!
Darn.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What about the roller coaster that's for kids? That might work!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It was down for maintenance last time, so we didn't get a chance to go on it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. They mentioned something about us being able to pop our heads out while having their phones in their pockets.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Len?
Are roller coasters too much for you...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't really say since I've never been on one...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But they go really fast, right?
Are you sure we won't fly away or anything?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Haha! We'll be fine!
Even little kids can go on this one♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it could be fun to be sent flying like that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold on. What happens after you get flung into the air?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, if it happened during a loop section, I could just fall back into my seat, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! 100 points for sticking the landing♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Alright, any other suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
How about the haunted house?
We didn't go there last time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: W-Wait, a haunted house...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It's supposed to be about this nightmare Phenny's having, but it's meant for all ages.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
So it's a fun haunted house...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But this isn't really your thing, right, Rin, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, but we didn't get to see it last time so I kind of want to go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. And it's meant for all ages, so how scary could it possibly be?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori even mentioned how it's fun to go through it more than once because of all the surprises they've put in place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see... That sounds interesting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, Len, you too?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we put this down as one we can go to if we have time during the day?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure Shizuku and Airi also have some rides that they'd like to go on as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, that sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I agree. Let's go with that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm for it too!
Hehe. I can't wait for it to be Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's take this opportunity to relax and have as much fun as we can♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, the coast is clear!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you, Airi, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa...
So this is Phoenix Wonderland?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There's a lot more people here than I expected too. Everything looks like so much fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Are you sure we can stay out like this? Won't anyone see us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, you should be fine.
Everyone seems to be focused on greeting Phenny.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, look at that! They're all waving at Phenny! Hey, over here!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Rin, wait! They'll see you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, let's start with some rides! You guys wanted to ride one of the roller coasters, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, that sounds wonderful♪
If that's okay with the both of you...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
Ready, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll be going on the one that's meant for children, so we should all be able to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yay!
I've been waiting so long for this!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Then, off to the roller coaster♪>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: <Yeah!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. That was so much fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Even though it's meant for little kids, it's hard not to feel a little anxious at the top.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<And after that, we all went, “Whoosh!”
I was really worried that we'd get blown away there.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I know, right?! It was kinda scary but still really fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm glad you all enjoyed it so much.
Next, we can...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, why don't we go over to the haunted house?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Phenny's Nightmare...
I guess we do have time for a haunted house run.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But Rin was right. It looks like it's meant to accommodate little kids.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <R-Right...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<It'll be fun!
Minori even said so!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever actually been inside the haunted house here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Why don't we all go since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Speak now, MEIKO, or forever hold your peace.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Huh? Wh-What are you talking about? I-It'll be fun, right...?>
Haunted House

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, it's so dark in here. I can't see where I'm walking. This is really a legit haunted house, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is. Where do you think all the ghosts and monsters are hiding?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <W-We don't need to find out...>

rows.Speaker: Skeleton
rows.Line: Aha... There... You... Are...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Look, MEIKO, a skeleton!
It looks so real...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Noooo!!
H-How is it moving...?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?! M-MEIKO?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Eep! It sounds like there's something on the floor...>

rows.Speaker: Zombie
rows.Line: W-Welcome... To... The... NIGHTMARE!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Airi, look! Beneath you!
Zombies! We need to get out of here!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Wow, that was a trap door...?
They really got me there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <D-Don't compliment them! Let's get out of here!!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<C-Calm down, you two!
They're just people in costumes, right?>

rows.Speaker: Skeleton
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh heh!
I'm gonna fry you all up good!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Aaahhhhh!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fry us up...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, because Phenny's having a bad dream?>

rows.Speaker: Skeleton
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh heh!
Everyone, get 'em!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Rin
rows.Line: <Nooooooo!!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<*Huff*... *Huff*...
F-Finally, we made it out...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-That was scary. Like, really scary!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <There, there. You all made it out in one piece, right?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Rin being scared is one thing, but I didn't expect you to be that scared by this place, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. Are you okay, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Y-Yes... I think so...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, MEIKO... Didn't I ask if you wanted to say anything before we went in?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <B-But they said that it's meant for children, so I couldn't really refuse at that point, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <S-Still... It was pretty scary...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Weren't you scared by anything, Len?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Huh? Me...?
If anything, the way you screamed really startled me, Rin.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And Miku wasn't bothered at all since she was too busy consoling all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <S-Sure, but I'm not sure I could handle anything scarier...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You and Luka seemed unfazed by everything, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it looked pretty realistic at first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I couldn't take them seriously after they welcomed us in and started talking. And they seemed really obsessed with “frying us up” for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They made me feel hungry after a while.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and none of those monsters really moved from where they appeared, so it sort of made it easy to get around them and enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What?! Seriously...?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I remember some trying to grab at me, but I guess they were never actually close enough to touch any of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <T-True...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I never would've realized that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. They must be positioned in a way to make sure children can roam around safely.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That makes sense. After all, this amusement park does seem pretty popular.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, why don't you two take some time to go on something you'd like, Airi, Shizuku?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <All that screaming seems to have taken a lot out of a few of us, so we'll go take a quick break in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sure? Alright, we'll check in to see how you guys are doing a little later!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you. But for now, please, go enjoy yourselves♪>
Court of Law

rows.Speaker: Government Official
rows.Line: All rise!

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Kayo Sudou...

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: You stand here today to face charges for the murders of Mirokuya and Mei. How do you plead?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Guilty, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Care to explain why?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: She came between my husband and myself.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: And you are also the one behind what happened to Mei's daughter, Miku, as well as her sister, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Guilty, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: She came between my husband and myself.

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line: Anything further...?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: No, your honor.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (No matter how many times anybody asks, my answer will not change...)

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (The rest of what I know will go with me to the grave...)
One year earlier
Enbizaka

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (I have not been sleeping well as of late... I may be more fatigued than I realize...)

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Regardless, I must deliver the kimono that the soba restaurant ordered...

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner A
rows.Line: Hey, it's that tailor...

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner B
rows.Line: The one that got caught in that fire four years ago? I remember her getting treated for those horrible burns, but I guess she's back.

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: Looks like it. But she seems so frightening now...

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: I was out with my kids the other day and happened to run into her, but she began leering at us for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner A
rows.Line: Hold on, you sure you didn't do anything to her?

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: No, of course not! We were just minding our own business when it happened.

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: Losing her “family” may have made her jealous of others who've managed to find happiness...

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: I even heard that she'd finally lost it. Rumor has it that she speaks as if her husband and son are still alive when no one is around.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner B
rows.Line:
I heard that too...
Something about her kid working for that Perrié guy at his shop, right?

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line:
Yes, that.
And how her husband is always out and never home.

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner
rows.Line:
Poor thing...
If only that fire had never happened...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Phew. Delivered as ordered.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: (But I still have plenty of other orders still unfinished. I should head home and...)

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
Well, if it isn't Kayo!
Out delivering a kimono?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Oh, Oyuka. Good evening.
Yes, I was just delivering a kimono to the soba restaurant.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Look at you. Already hard at work just after coming back. Eikichi could learn so much from you.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Eikichi...? Oh, the private detective?
You are both from the same village, yes?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Yes, and because of that, he's got it in his mind that he can slack off and use my shop as a hideout.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: I know! Why don't you get him to find the perp that started that fire four years ago?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
Oh... I'm sorry, Kayo.
I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: No need to apologize... You lost your store to that fire as well, so I know you understand.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: S-Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: You have nothing to worry about when it comes to me. After all, Oyuka, I have you to talk to.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Are you sure that's enough...?

Sorry about that...
Having you deal with one of them like this.

No, it's okay...
It was really no trouble.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Oh, it's Mirokuya and his wife, Mei.

rows.Speaker: Mei
rows.Line: I really would rather have you treat that burn instead of fussing over me so much...

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Nonsense. Look, my fingers are moving fine now.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
So many were lost to that fire.
We have the gods to thank for us still being here.

rows.Speaker: Mei
rows.Line: I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: He got caught up in that fire too...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Oyuka...
Please, excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka's Voice
rows.Line:
Sure.
Come visit again soon.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Back to work...
The next day

rows.Speaker: Oyuka's Voice
rows.Line:
Kayo, it's terrible!!
How can you be sweeping like nothing's happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Oyuka?
You seem startled.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Wrong doesn't even begin to describe it! Mirokuya's wife...! Mei...! She...! She's...!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Oh my...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: It happened last night. Must've been some rogue or rebel. They even took that red kimono right off her back.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: And just when I thought that things would finally go back to the way they were.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: You need to be careful out there, Kayo. Even if it's for work, it's not safe to walk around at night when there aren't any people around.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Thank you for this, Oyuka.
Please, stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
I will.
Wait... I left my shop wide open!
See you later, Kayo!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Anyway, back to work.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: I should start by doing something about this hole in the breast area.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner
rows.Line: Run! Hurry! The fire's already spread this far!!

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: No... Please...! Help! My baby! Has anybody seen my baby?! Someone, please...!!

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: What are you doing?! You need to get out of here!

rows.Speaker: Female Commoner
rows.Line: No, let go of me...! Without them, I'll...!

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Your kid's got a good head on their shoulders! I'm sure they ran to safety already, so...

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner
rows.Line: Watch out! The roof's about to collapse!! Run!!

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
Huh...? Oh...
Aaahhhhh!!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Aaahhhhh!!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: That dream again...
Enbizaka

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Gonkichi's tuna takoyaki's really the best, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: You don't look well, Kayo. For a while now too. Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: No, I must be tired from not getting enough sleep...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Is that all? Well, to be fair, a lot has been happening lately...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: I never thought that they'd end up going after Mirokuya's two girls too.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Honestly, what are the police and detectives doing?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: But they seem to have assigned him a guard detail.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: I saw that too. If they get to him, you can say goodbye to the magistrate's office.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: When did this become such a dangerous place to live...?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line:
The People in Red, was it...?
Haven't heard much about them in a while either...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Just when we all started settling back in, this happens.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Do you like Enbizaka, Oyuka?

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Me? Well, sure...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: When I first came here after getting married, I sort of couldn't believe what I saw. All these foreigners with bright-colored hair.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: But after a while, I realized that we're one in the same. We just want to eat good food, smile, drink and have fun...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: I really do love this place now that I think about it...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Yes, I understand.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Oyuka...

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Thank you... For everything...
I appreciate all that you have done for me.

rows.Speaker: Oyuka
rows.Line: Haha. What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
A few weeks later
Near Enbizaka at Mt. Inasa

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
*Huff*... *Huff*...
I can rest here for now.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Tired, are we?

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
Oh, uh, hello.
I didn't expect to see anyone else around here.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Nice to make your acquaintance.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Likewise...

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: But what are you doing out here...?

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
Your red kimono...!
It's Mei's... It was made just for her!!

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
Your sash and hairpin too...!
Those belonged to my daughters...!!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: You are correct, Kai.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: It was all me.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
Look at you, all skin and bones...
You must be exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Why...? How...?

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: I began seeing this Purple Dream a while back...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: In that dream, I convince myself that you are my husband and that you keep chasing after other women...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: At the end, after we greet each other, I became so enraged that I ended up making you suffer the same fate as the others.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: However, right now, I know that you are not my husband.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: No... Stay away...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line:
I know why you are here.
I know what you are doing.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Your base of operations is somewhere on this mountain, is it not, Kai of the People in Red?

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: What...?! How did you...?!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: You told me, in my dream.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: How you started that fire four years ago and took my husband and son away from me...

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line:
And you're seeking vengeance?!
The truth won't save you now!

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: If anything, the truth will start an all-out war between the magistrate's office and my people!

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: And Enbizaka will have to pay once more...!

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Yes, I am fully aware of these circumstances. Like how your group is holding something over the magistrate's office.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: And they certainly cannot go after you and your group even if they know that you were behind that fire.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: S-So...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: However, I am not about to let you go.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Vengeance... No, this is envy...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: To think that you were living a happy life while the rest of us suffered and lost loved ones.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: It was maddening...

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: Wait... No, please...

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: You have nothing to worry about. The truth will go with me to the grave and Enbizaka will stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Kayo
rows.Line: Now, it is time to begin... My final order.

rows.Speaker: Kai
rows.Line: A-Aaahhhhh!!
Enbizaka

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner A
rows.Line: They caught whoever did in Mirokuya and his family?!

rows.Speaker: Male Commoner B
rows.Line:

rows.Line: Yeah, I don't remember all of it either, so I'll take a look too.

rows.Speaker: Luka

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Alright, everyone, are you ready?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An

rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, wasn't seeing a real forest originally your idea, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sure, but all I did was make a small suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Luka

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, because I remember seeing a certain someone really cut loose and go all out.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All I was trying to do was lead by example. Honest♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But I know what you mean.
Whenever I'm teaching Rin and Len something, I try to make it a fun learning experience.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I suppose that if everybody else is having fun, it's hard not to go along with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Very true.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Maybe♪
Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, thinking about Toya and the others just made me realize something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Realize what?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know how they're very impressionable and can change quite a bit after meeting someone or doing something?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if they sort of took that to heart and began looking for ways to grow on their own...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Imagine how fun it would be to see that happen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it certainly would be.
Like seeing your own student blaze their own trail.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly! It's never a dull moment with them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can see why you guys kept such a close eye on them, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That means a lot coming from you, Luka, since you're always wandering around looking for something more fun to do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Haha! True.
I just seem to be naturally drawn towards things or places that pique my interest.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I have a feeling that I'll never get bored of them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So do I. There's just something about them that makes you want to see what happens next, you know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah, that! I mean, even KAITO seems really interested in them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
