rows.Line: That time, Rui said that he was able to tell us about what was going on because we're fellow show performers.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But... Aren't the others on the cheer squad also his fellow performers?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I sure hope he finds a way to break the spell that prevents him from being open with anyone other than Emu, us or the others before the Sports Festival...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too... Wait, hang on!
The Sports Festival's today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it is?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO and the others must be getting ready to head over now, so we're going to see if this so called spell's been broken too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you, MEIKO.
Kamiyama High School - Campus

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Great work during the events, everyone! We will now be announcing how things currently stand.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Following that, it'll be time for Kamiyama High School's famed cheering competition. We will be passing out voting slips to everybody watching, so please make sure you get one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Oh wow. Look at all the people.
It really is a festival.)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Oh, they're about to announce the standings. I bet the red team's in first right now!

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: Maybe, but the green team's also been doing pretty well. Plus, the cheering competition's right after this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're all smiling and having so much fun. But this bunch seems...)

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: I'm so sorry for tripping back there...!

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: No, it's okay! That wouldn't have happened if only I'd passed the sash to you better during the relay.

rows.Speaker: Female Student C
rows.Line:
Alright, enough negative talk!
You guys still managed to get second because you stuck it out until the end, right?

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Right! Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. That's nice...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Oh...?
My chest... It feels warm...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Whoa! It's almost time for the cheering competition! I'm getting super duper excited☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Miku... Hello.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hey, you shouldn't jump out like that. What if someone sees you?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry!
I can't wait to see the cheering competition because Rui worked so hard on it!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hey, Luka! Wake up!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Mhm?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Don't give me that...
We were definitely about to lose you there. What happened to you having trouble falling asleep?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. But it looks like everybody's having so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
I promise to do what I can to meet your expectations.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Has Rui...?)

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Here are the current standings...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay...>

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The red team is in the lead by a large margin with the green team trailing behind and the blue team in last.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no! Rui and the blue team are in trouble!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it's rather unfortunate.
However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This may make things just that much more interesting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You have that look on your face, Rui. I'm looking forward to what you have in store for us during the cheering competition.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. You seem just as happy, Luka.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, that's because...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It looks like Rui found a way to break that spell.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. I can't wait to see what kind of performance Rui and his friends have in store for us.)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's such a lovely day for a nap...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Shall I sleep on the grass?
Or doze off in one of the coffee cups as it spins me around?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? That must be...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Luka! Hello!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Luka! We came to visit☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello, everyone... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! She fell asleep while standing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? You're going to watch the Sports Festival?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The broadcasting club took a commemorative video, so we decided to have a watch party.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Emu wasn't able to make it because of her own club activities.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Luka, you and the others had to stay hidden from everyone else, so I'm sure there are some events that you didn't really get a chance to see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha. Be glad that I was able to get my classmate from the broadcasting committee to obtain a copy of said video!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, they're already here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Have you guys started the watch party already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Len! Everyone!
No, we haven't started yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting!
We're all set for the watch party♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay. I can't wait to see it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me neither♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, let's play it!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The Kamiyama High School Sports Festival has begun! Our opening event is turning into a heated battle for first place between the red and blue teams!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can do it, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've got this, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, I know him!
He was in the flash mob for that wedding!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, he was?
He's such a fast runner!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. My legs would get all twisted and tangled if I tried to run like that.

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Alright, the mixed ball toss is usually a drama-filled event each year, and it looks like the green team's having a bit of a tough go at it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! That's another!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, they were in the flash mob too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Who are they?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Look, it's Nene!
You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That one was so close!
I'm sure you'll get the next one!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
But you know this is a video, right...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're right! I forgot!

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That's so strange. It's not like Emu, the others or I participated in the Sports Festival, but we're all getting really excited.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! You guys' performance was so good, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Despite being a video, it still felt incredibly powerful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. And the green team had to follow that up... Pretty tough break, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, look! The blue team's performance is about to start!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: For the blue teeeaaam!!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
What?!
Wait... The rooftop?!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
It's the Captain of the blue team!
The other squad members are by the classroom windows too... What are they all doing there...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Th-They jumped!
Cool!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that part really caught everyone by surprise. Not only that, they used the building as a projection screen.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Pulling out all the stops to make sure they were able to put on the best performance possible is a very Rui thing to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was think of this idea. I have my fellow squad members to thank for actually going through with it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Hehe. The Rui in the video has such a beautiful smile on his face.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO, mind if I borrow your lap?
Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh? Luka?
I didn't say you could.

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Did Luka fall asleep?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She seems very happy, so why don't we just let her be?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, okay☆
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just want to be able to compose a song that can save people... I need to do everything I can to achieve that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's my goal...
That's what I have to compose...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kanade...!
Would it be alright for me to give you my support?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um... In my case...
If I keep pushing myself after deciding to do something, I start getting really tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, if you think you need it, Kanade, even if things get really tough or difficult, I want to give you my support in a way that helps you move forward...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I kept an eye on how Kanade was doing all day, but it was very interesting to see her give exercising a try even though she's not very used to it.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I was told by one of them today that they wanted to “see me smile”, and how everyone in N25 probably feels the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was kind of startled since it was the first time I'd ever been told anything like that. However...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If what they said is true... If they all feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll take what you said into closer consideration, Luka, and think more about how I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (If she thinks more about how she herself is doing...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(If Kanade begins doing that...
I wonder how it'll affect the music she composes.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing that change.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
It's rare of you to come to meet me yourself, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've been grinning for a while now... Just what exactly are you scheming this time?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me? Scheming?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Were you sitting by yourself and grinning again, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did something fun happen...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you mean “grinning”?
I was crying just now because something very sad happened.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is that true...?
I'm sorry, I didn't know.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: M-Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't fall for that...
I guarantee that she's lying.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Rin, you're so mean.
I was just joking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
How's that supposed to be fun?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Of course it's fun.
We're close friends enjoying a little bit of playful banter.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not sure this actually amounts to “banter”...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Let's move over there, Miku, Len.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you don't want to hear the story about how I saw Kanade struggling to stand up while wearing rollerblades like a newborn fawn?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A newborn fawn...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rollerblades...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you've been gone from SEKAI all day. Did you go off to see Kanade during that time...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I did.
I was told that Kanade and Ena would be going out for a walk today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't believe they went from that to rollerblading, playing bubble sumo and some other things.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Bubble sumo?
What kind of “bubble”?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to hear more?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, as long as you stay on topic...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be going now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll tell the rest of you about all the things I saw Kanade do today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're here♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Where's Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She won't be able to make it because of cram school.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, why did you ask us to gather here in SEKAI? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I have an important favor to ask.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An important favor?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'd like to try exercising.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Y-You want to exercise?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, Kanade, we heard that you and Ena were able to exercise quite a bit at a place called “SpoJoy Park”...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I see. That explains why you want to try exercising all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, that's great and all, but how do you want to go about actually exercising? We don't have what we need for rollerblading, bubble sumo or strike zone here...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess this is a bit sudden...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena, you made them cry.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
N-No, I didn't!
Don't yank my chain like that!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... We may not have the equipment for those things... So, how about a walk?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's fine, but I prefer something more fun...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So it's not fine.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
We have this many people here...
Hmm... Something fun... Like tag?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, how about zombie tag?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Normally, you'll switch who's it each time you get tagged. However, with zombie tag, you don't switch. If you get tagged, you also get to be it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the game usually ends when we all become zombies, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Or we can set a time limit and declare whoever didn't get tagged the winners. But if the zombies get everyone, they win!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay, I believe we have a plan.
Oh, I can start as the first zombie if nobody else wants to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do my best to get all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
W-Wait... This seems bad...
Almost as bad as making someone like Mafuyu be it first...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There should also be a limit in terms of how far you can all run. For example...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See the four truss towers that are around us? Why don't we make it so you can all run around and hide as long as you stay within those boundaries?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! That should be just right for the numbers we have!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And I'll set a timer on my phone...
Luka, come and get us after you finish counting to ten!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Okay, that's ten seconds...
Where could Luka be...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line:
Oh, Mafuyu, when did you get here?
Good timing too. We were just playing a game together.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line:
Mafuyu's here?
Huh? Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Are you all done with cram school?
Huh? Wait... Where's Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
She was obviously lying...
Honestly, they fell for that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, they're all the honest type...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike a certain someone...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Excuse me?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Found you.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo! And the winner is... Me♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-I totally forgot how fast you are, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-It was a good workout...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it was just us chasing after Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, Luka, you didn't help at all in the end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it turned out to be so different from what I originally imagined.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was under the impression that everyone would become suspicious of who was it and try to play their cards right.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, were you hoping that you'd get to observe how things unfolded as the game went on?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Alas, I went a little overboard and ended up finding more people than I was expecting...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, who's up for round two?
I promise to find all of you much slower.

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Co.
rows.Line:
I'll pass...
No way...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, let's play again the next chance we get. Hehehe...
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that was the first music video I'd ever made...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So you discovered the music Kanade and Mafuyu had made, as well as Ena's art, during a time when you didn't want to go to school?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why didn't you want to go to school, Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I suppose she couldn't help but ask.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Which is only natural...
Mizuki goes to school only when absolutely necessary, while talking about it like everything is normal.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Which means whatever issue Mizuki was dealing with before still hasn't been resolved...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Why...? Well, a lot of reasons...
Most of all, it just felt like such a drag...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm guessing we would've gotten a real answer if whatever this issue is had already been resolved...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And what happened after you sent Ena that message...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, after I sent it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: See you again, Miku, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
See you...
Thank you for telling us that story, Mizuki, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
We'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were treated to a very interesting story today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was nice to learn more about everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. However, it also raised more questions.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is this about Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes... Remember when you asked Mizuki about not wanting to go to school, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
There were a lot of reasons and it became too much of a drag...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you wondering what Mizuki meant by “a lot of reasons”, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Well, there's that, and...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki gave us a fairly quick answer and didn't seem to think much about what to say.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I can't get that out of my mind.
It felt like Mizuki was giving us a preprogrammed response to your question.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Pre...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Like how you teach a robot to move and behave.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I understand your confusion.
To be a little more precise...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: After being asked the same question so many times, instead of going through the trouble of coming up with something to say each time, one may rather use a boilerplate response, like a robot.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Mizuki's response was so brief...
On the surface, it sounded like Mizuki meant it. But upon closer inspection, it felt like a preprogrammed response.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At least, that's what I heard.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I may be reading into things too much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, I'm also convinced that we won't know how Mizuki actually feels unless we do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. I think I know what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm still a bit surprised...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you didn't ask Mizuki anything, even though you always seem to have a lot going through your head...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I may've asked something if I hadn't overheard what MEIKO told Ena that one time.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Feel better through talking...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would that actually work?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Make things worse? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You must've already been aware of how Mizuki felt about talking, MEIKO, and how it probably wouldn't have helped.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I haven't actually talked to Mizuki about this, so I don't actually know for certain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because of what you said, MEIKO, I've decided to be patient and wait until Mizuki's ready to talk.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She'll wait until Mizuki's ready to talk...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Ena's decision gives Mizuki less inclination to actually say anything.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can't say if that's a good or bad thing for Mizuki... However, for some reason, it seems like there's been progress...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Could it be because Mizuki never really met anyone until this point who was willing to simply wait?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That may be why it feels like things haven't stagnated.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(People are so interesting...
Mafuyu in particular, but also Mizuki, Kanade and Ena.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to seeing where their choices take them.)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I thought your next song was going to be good after hearing the rough draft of it the other day, but you found a way to make it even better.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I did get stuck a few times, but I'm hoping this is enough for all of you to get started on everything else...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll get to work on my rough draft once I get back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to hear more about what this song's about...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Mizuki, thank you for inviting me out to that cafe the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What cafe...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We decided to try going to a cafe to work as a little change of pace.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, and it was the first time we got to see how we all work! It felt like a totally new perspective.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But Kanade had trouble focusing because of everyone else that was there...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: However, after I returned home and got back to work, I figured out the part I was stuck at, so I think it was worth the trip.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really? You said before that you enjoyed it, but I feel a lot better knowing that it actually helped.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
So...
What was it like to work on stuff at a cafe...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You always work on a computer, right, Kanade? Did you take that with you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no. I just took my notebook and wrote music in that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu worked on her phone and notepad...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We brought tablets and worked using those...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Working on your music at a cafe. Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're snickering. Is it that interesting...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Don't you find it interesting, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were the second to arrive here, so I was under the impression that you'd have a better feel for things than me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A better feel? Of what...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How things have been changing...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, precisely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Knowing what they were like when you first arrived here, Rin, could you have seen them going to a cafe together to work on their music?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I guess not...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: One thing after another seems to have led to them understanding one another better and bringing about a more relaxed atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't say if they realize this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But their actions appear to be leading to change, and they're having fun in the process.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You think so? As for me...
I'm not really sure what's good or bad, or fun for that matter...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's a possibility that the change they're experiencing doesn't lead to a happy ending.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very thoughtful of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're just not very nice, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? It makes my heart ache when I see the others in pain.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Uh huh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know if this is related at all, but you seem to be changing as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember what you said when you first arrived here? About wanting to break the status quo?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that hasn't changed one bit.
However, I don't see the need to actively pursue that right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, in essence, you've learned to heel...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then... Good girl, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so mean.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
However...
Just watching what they do has been very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This place is like a gift that keeps on giving.
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It sounds like...someone's singing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's Miku and the others from one of the SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can feel the emotions pouring out of their song. It must have been reborn from Untitled.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: SEKAI are born from feelings and true feelings give birth to songs...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And by singing those songs, we're able to connect those feelings no matter how far they are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's not very often you come across something so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I'll join in and sing along to this song.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? I think I heard someone speak just now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's coming from that SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That SEKAI looks quite dark. And that voice I heard... It sounded like Miku...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I should probably go and have a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So this is the SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It's very chilly here. It looks like the middle of some forest...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm pretty sure it was Miku's presence I felt before... But it looks like neither I nor the others are here...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Untitled has yet to turn into its own song... Which means the person who holds these feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: ...nothing. I can't sense anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But with the way this SEKAI looks and how it was formed, it's strange that it's not emitting any emotions...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Maybe it's cause they haven't visited this SEKAI in a very long time.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That means the Miku in this SEKAI has always been all alone...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can see something over there. I should take a look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So this is what I saw.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... It looks like an egg but it's as hard as stone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And there's so many of them all around here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why eggs...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe this person is an artist or a creator of some sort. It looks like they were trying to make something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But then why are they in the shape of eggs as opposed to the finished products themselves?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: These eggs could symbolize the beginnings of those works, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's just too many things that don't make sense.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I feel nothing.
Anything about the person who bears these feelings or even the emotions that birthed this SEKAI... I can't feel any of it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I wonder what was supposed to come from these eggs...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (They're so cold... I guess that's to be expected since they've turned into stone...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... There's a finely carved design here. If I didn't touch it, I wouldn't have noticed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not sure what this person was trying to create, but... I'm sure they were very attentive and deliberate in every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And this egg must've been filled with passion and warmth during that time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I don't want to bother Miku and the others that live in other SEKAI when I visit, so I usually try not to overstay my welcome, but...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Is there really no way for me to get a sense of any of the emotions that formed this SEKAI?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I saw someone just now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Could it be...the Miku of this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (For every SEKAI, it's Miku's role to guide the owner of these feelings while the rest of us try to not interfere as much as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But maybe there was a reason why I heard her voice, which led me here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I want to know a little more about this SEKAI and the owner of these feelings...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku. I'll be exploring this SEKAI for a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There are a lot of eggs that turned into stone around here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They all look the same as the ones back there, and are just as carefully crafted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (All of the eggs before looked like they were placed, whereas these ones looked like they were randomly tossed around here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Almost as though they were thrown away...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Could this be some sort of manifestation of the owner's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's this? There's more eggs over there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... This egg is cracked...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Actually, no it's not...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It was broken...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (All of the eggs around it look like they were broken too.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And there's...no more eggs beyond this path...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't sense any emotions so this is just an assumption, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think the owner of these feelings probably experienced some sort of setback or failure.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And that's why they can't bring themselves to try making anything again...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There were countless eggs scattered on the way here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This person had taken the time and effort to carefully craft so many works and yet...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe... All of them went unnoticed and never came to fruition. Then all that's left is for them to turn into cold stone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't begin to imagine...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What this person must have been feeling...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (What made them so frustrated, so stressed and so upset that they felt the need to destroy these eggs like this...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is awful.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If my assumption is correct, then there should be some powerful emotions lingering here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But maybe so much time has passed that those feelings faded away to the point where we can barely sense them anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (If that's the case... How long has Miku from this SEKAI been alone...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Do they want me to follow them?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I understand. I'll go where you go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is quite an open space.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's a row of small stones here and they're all evenly spaced out... Are those flowers and more broken eggs?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This looks like some sort of cemetery to bury the eggs...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Does this mean that the owner of these feelings has already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's still more over there.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's this? There's an egg here... It looks smaller in comparison to the others, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
This one isn't cracked nor has it turned into stone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's warm too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see... I'm so relieved.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The owner of these feelings... They're still...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... There are flower buds surrounding only this egg. I wonder if Miku planted them here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope the feelings that this egg bears will come to fruition much like how these sprouting buds will someday bloom into flowers.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh precious egg, there's someone here who's patiently waiting for you to hatch.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So for their sake... I hope you join us soon.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You want to come into this world too, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's why you're still so small and full of warmth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I wonder if this person knows that there's still some feelings lingering here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Since this SEKAI and these emotions haven't disappeared, and Miku is still waiting... Would they ever come back?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I knew there was a reason why I heard Miku's voice and was led to this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (That's what I think. And I hope it's true.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (For Miku of this SEKAI, for the feelings that got left behind...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And for the owner of these feelings...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Your precious feelings are still here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (They are waiting here with Miku for you to return.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Once feelings and SEKAI are born, they'll never disappear. That's because they are a part of you.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Even if you forget all about them, and even if you thought you've lost them...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (They are still here.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (As long as your feelings are here and together with Miku, there's no such thing as “too late”.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (So please, someway or somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I hope this reaches you...)
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: That song just now...
Christmas Eve
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪ Humhumhuum♪ Christmas Eve is here♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're humming, Luka. I take it that you're in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because we're having a party on Christmas Eve! You're excited about it too, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
By the way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The Santa decoration you're trying to put up looks a bit crooked, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Hmm... I think he looks cute. It's like he's inquisitively tilting his head.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rin's Voice
rows.Line:
Len, no.
That long, twisty, sparkly one needs to be wrapped around the tree.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I know. That's why I'm wrapping it like... Wait, it keeps looping around the same part for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, you won't reach the bottom if you don't wrap it at a slight angle. Gimme that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You tilt it a bit in the beginning and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...? U-Uhh... It keeps slipping...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
See what I mean?!
I couldn't get it to hook for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why is that? Can't we fix this somehow?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. Look, Santa's elves are also tilting their heads.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, good for you. I'm going to help out over there, so try to straighten Santa up in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're no fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That should do it.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We're done!!!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We've also finished putting up all our decorations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
The food's just about ready.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As per your requests, we've made pizza and soup! Come get it while it's hot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Naturally, we also have a cake ready!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this is turning into a nice Christmas Eve feast! Everyone, get your drinks ready!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we're all set!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Merry Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Glug*
Ahh...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The fact that we get to have a party on Christmas Eve and a party on Christmas Day makes this such a wonderful time of year!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're having two because a certain someone said they wanted to, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. I wonder who that could be♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, if they hadn't, I have a feeling that someone else would've suggested that we do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree completely!
See? KAITO understands!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, who would like some cake?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me! I would!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, just give me one moment!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You sound more excited than before, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that because he wants to have some cake?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, there is that...
But just sit back and watch.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience! I'll start cutting it now... Here should do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, perfect!
Everyone, please look at where I just cut it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool! It looks like tulips!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I got it! You used strawberries and kiwis for these, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Correct! We carefully placed strawberries and kiwis in certain spots to have the cross sections appear as tulips when cut properly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad it worked, KAITO, since we had to be very precise in terms of angles and placement.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I couldn't be happier.
Now to actually have some of it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it's so cute. It seems a shame to eat it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. If you don't want your slice, Rin, then I'll have it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! No way!
I'm gonna eat it if you're planning on stealing it from me!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Merry Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Merry Christmas!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us to your Christmas party, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad you're here, but also sorry. You were all just having a party at An and her father's place, yes?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's no need to apologize since that party had just wrapped up. Also, we did promise to partake in this one.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, you did! I'm certainly glad that you kept your promise.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way, did you all enjoy your other party?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We got to have these special Christmas honey waffles! You should've seen how happy Akito looked!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, I wasn't the only one.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
The pizza's ready!
It's very hot, so please be careful!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Now seems like a good time...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Everyone, it's time to start the bingo tournament! Please feel free to keep eating while we play!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The rules are simple! Each time someone gets a bingo, they get to choose one of the presents on the table to take home!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Luka, you and the others will be choosing from the presents we brought, while we choose from yours, yes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Correct♪ Oh, but no peeking.
It'll be more fun if we keep everything a secret♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Interesting. Bingo already requires a certain amount of luck, but which presents we get in the end will be dictated by that as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel kind of bad since you won't be able to use what we got for you outside of here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you all put a lot of thought into these, right? I really can't wait to see what you got for us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I'm sure they'll be pleasantly surprised when they see that we included some coupons for unlimited toppings.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start playing bingo!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our next number is...“14”.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, another hit for me♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Same here.
Next is a “1”.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
A “1”... Oh, here!
I'm just one away from bingo♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Luka, you have every number that's been called so far?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Miku's also doing pretty well.
The race is on between her and Luka!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Next, we have a...“6”.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“6”... Oh, look at that!
I'm one away on two lines now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're kidding, right?! I'm so far behind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You seem to be having trouble too, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Zero hits so far.
At this rate, I might take home a clean card...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Next is a “3”...? Oh, bingo.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No! You beat me by a nose!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I only need a “30” or “27” too...!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I did it! I finally got a bingo!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That just leaves Luka and Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What happened Luka? You were the closest to winning in the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's what I want to know!
I only need a “30” or “27”!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I need a “13”...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I don't want to finish last!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can only take the presents that are left, so you're both already sort of in last place.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Then, this will determine who finishes truly last.

rows.Speaker: Luka & Akito
rows.Line:
Don't say it like that!
Please don't put it like that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll draw the next number.
Let's see... It's thir...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nope. “13”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes! Bingo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Congratulations, Luka! You finish in last place!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: How can I feel happy about that...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But you still get a present.
You never know. There could be something good inside.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
T-True...
I guess I'll try opening it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Coupons? For unlimited toppings...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Akito got them!
As written, you can have whatever toppings you like for coffee or pancakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's nice...
Congratulations, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, wow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I got... Shoes with springs?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They're a pair of Hopper Kings.
You can jump really high when you wear them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun!
I think I'll give them a try right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not here. You'll throw dust into the air, and I don't want that to get on everyone's food and the cake. If you're going to try them out, do it outside.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(But these do look like fun!
I can't wait to try them out♪)
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
Shall we take a break? We have sung for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I think we're at a good place to.

rows.Line: Thank you for introducing our program!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Viewers, our guest for today is Megurine Luka, the VIRTUAL SINGER!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's wonderful to be here.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: As we've been telling our viewers on the show these last few days, the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show is set to be held in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And so! Here on “Get on Those Hot Topics!”, we've been bringing on the participating VIRTUAL SINGERS to hear what they all have to say.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. There's a lot I want to talk about, so I've been looking forward to this.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I see! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let's get down to it... Or so I'd like to say, but first, I'll give a brief introduction of Luka to our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: She's Megurine Luka, a VIRTUAL SINGER. This beautiful pink hair of hers is quite iconic.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And she's also known for being bilingual and singing many songs in both Japanese and English.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I suppose that isn't as special as it used to be, but I'm happy to be able to bring people songs in multiple languages.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That humble smile, how wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: You can feel Luka's unique charm from her calm, mature disposition and grace.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And on the topic of Luka, she also became a hot topic in the news surrounding a recently announced exhibition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ah, you mean the New Breeze & Reboot Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Can we start by talking about the exhibition?

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: This exhibition is set to be held at a satellite venue tied in with the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Not just music, but illustrations, photos, woodblock prints, sculptures, you name it. All manner of VIRTUAL SINGER art from creators of all disciplines, brought together under one roof!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <A “new breeze”... Just like the exhibition's name evokes, you'll be able to see many works from up-and-coming creators.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We may find that the creators who'll define the next generation will get their start there!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. But a new breeze may not be all that you feel.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <As the “reboot” in the name suggests, we also want this exhibition to be a place where established creators can once again leave their mark.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The artist who's getting the most attention right now is the sculptor Masaki Sono.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: He'd taken time off from creating to focus on his health in recent years, but with the announcement that he'll be returning to action with his work based on Luka, he's now the subject of much discussion.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I've had the opportunity to see some of Mr. Sono's works myself, and he makes quite detailed pieces with his delicate touch.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He does. I never expected I'd be the subject of one of his works, but I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: By the way, it seems that the reason he chose to use you as a theme was because one day, when he was wandering around town, he heard your singing and felt it resound strongly in his heart.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It resounded in his heart...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<If that's the case, I'm very glad.
I'm sure the creator who had me sing that song would be happy to hear it as well.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you for speaking with us today, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It was my pleasure. I had a wonderful time.
Please allow me to come back and chat again.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Of course, that would be delightful!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We've reached the end of our talk, but please look forward to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And the New Breeze & Reboot Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Luka & Host
rows.Line:
<We hope you enjoy them.>
We hope you enjoy them.

rows.Line: “Far, far away in the deep reaches of outer space, we find the Star Princess traveling from planet to planet.”

rows.Line:
“Honestly, how can Father do this to me?

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “Has he forgotten that I'm a star with the power to grant wishes? I should be allowed to find my own future spouse!”

rows.Line: “She loves to go on adventures, and has encountered a myriad of lifeforms in her travels.”

rows.Line:
“But she was yet to find the one...

*Scream*

rows.Line:

rows.Line: “The one...?”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “The princess and the boy began spending a series of fun albeit hectic days together. However...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line:
“No, I don't want to go home...!
I'm not ready to leave this planet yet!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “You wish to spend more time with this human boy, yes?”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “Princess, he does not exist on the same time scale as you. It is impossible for you two to be together.”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “I know parting with each other will be very hard on the both of you. Allow me to use my powers to have you forget about one another...”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “No, I don't want that... I don't want to forget about him...!”

rows.Speaker: Star Princess
rows.Line: “It's not happening!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line:
“What?!
The power of your growth deflected my spell...?”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “Oh no! Princess!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “She succeeded in preserving the memories which came to mean so much to her. However, she also exhausted all of her strength, and fell into a deep slumber.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“And there was only one way to wake her.
To wish for her to open her eyes. To wish and never stop...”

rows.Speaker: Human Boy
rows.Line: “I'm going to keep wishing for as long as I possibly can! Until she wakes back up!”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line: “Understood. I shall impart some of my powers unto her, and place her as a star visible from this planet.”

rows.Speaker: Star King
rows.Line:
“Her fate is in your hands.
Keep wishing. Do not stop until the day she regains her brilliant glow.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You can do it, Princess!

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“The boy kept wishing.
Even on rainy days when he couldn't actually see her, he kept wishing and wishing...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Days became months. Months became a year. Two years. Five years. And before he knew it, ten years had passed.”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line:
“Princess...

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “To think that we would be separated for this long... Am I just not wishing hard enough?”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “No, I can't think like that!”

rows.Speaker: Human Man
rows.Line: “We're going to see each other again, and I'm going to tell her how I feel. I don't care if it takes fifty or a hundred years. I'm going to keep on wishing!”

rows.Speaker: Human Man

rows.Speaker: Star Princess's Voice
rows.Line:
*Scream*
“Someone, catch me!!!”
